_doc: Mode rewards and unlock rules. Currency in $, XP in points.

timeTrial._firstMedalOnly: medal payouts are paid in full the first time you earn that medal tier on a course; repeats pay 25%

modes.name: Freeride
modes.description: Explore Frostpine Valley, hunt frost crystals, find scenic viewpoints and throw down at trick spots. Change the time of day and weather, then snap it in photo mode.

modes.name: Time Trial
modes.tagline: Beat the clock. Beat your ghost.
modes.description: Checkpoint courses across mixed snow. Race your best-run ghost for bronze, silver and gold.

modes.name: Delivery
modes.description: Pick up cargo and deliver it to remote cabins against the clock.

modes.name: Snocross
modes.description: Race five AI riders around Frostpine Arena: berms, tabletops, a double, whoops and a rhythm section. Faster sleds, faster rivals.

modes.name: Special Delivery
modes.tagline: Don't stop. Don't get boxed in.
modes.description: Carry a suspicious package while federal agents give chase.
